description: Extended concurrency sweep on 5-orderer Raft cluster: C={1,4,16,32,64}, 3 seeds, 10 tx/thread, peer chaincode invoke CLI workload. Identifies native CLI saturation point.

key_findings.saturation_point_identified: C=16 is the throughput sweet spot (44.65 TPS). C=32 shows TPS DROP (39.67) with 50% failure rate. C=64 throughput partially recovers but 50% failures persist.
key_findings.native_CLI_ceiling: ~45 TPS via peer chaincode invoke CLI on this hardware. To exceed, must use Fabric Gateway SDK (Caliper showed 468 TPS at rate-500).
key_findings.p99_latency_growth_with_C: C=1: 339ms; C=16: 380ms; C=32: 471ms; C=64: 717ms — superlinear after saturation
key_findings.matches_caliper_observation: η Caliper sustained 468 TPS via SDK; native CLI ceiling at 45 TPS — 10× gap attributable to per-invoke CLI startup cost

related_phases.eta: 5node_caliper_clean_2026-06-07 (Fabric Gateway SDK ~468 TPS — 10x above native CLI's ~45 TPS ceiling)
related_phases.delta: 5node_saturation_delta_2026-06-08 (530 TPS saturation plateau via SDK — confirms CLI is not the blockchain bottleneck)
